note: Private RV park 1 mi east of Wagner on SD-46, 13 mi east of Pickstown and Fort Randall Dam. A gravel grid of 70 large pads on open farmland, sold by the night, week, month or year; permanent campers may add decks and sheds. On-site Pad 71 bar with video lottery and pizza; horseshoes, volleyball, pickleball and a playground. --Claude
summary: Operator site (+Wix booking) + Google + imagery: 70 pads 70x13 ft, full hookups (amps unstated), $40 nightly bookable online ('overnight stays welcome!'), week/month/year rates, permanent campers allowed decks/sheds; bar on site. Under the price gate. Long-stay: reviewer's call. Electric amperage cleared; booking now operator online.
flags: LONG-STAY (reviewer's call): operator offers 'a permanent spot, monthly, weekly, or daily rates', a YEARLY $2,250 rate, and 'Decks are allowed on campers. Storage sheds also ... the camping people do their own trimming' - residential signs. Against: the home page leads with DAILY $40, the booking page sells 'Daily RV Accommodations - overnight stays welcome!', and the (winter) imagery shows ~6 units on ~70 pads. Nightly share not measurable from any source; nothing discourages nightly guests. Keep recommended with the note saying permanent campers are taken.
GOOGLE: 4.7 stars, only 7 reviews (thin presence; own site with prices and online booking is the presence indicator).
PRICE GATE: $40 nightly (live 2026-11-21; service pages archived 2025-07 to 2026-07) - passes; one price year-round.
HOOKUPS: electric 50 -> null (current operator pages give no amperage).
BOOKING: platform operator with url /book-online (stored had no platform).
PHONE 605-384-5555 confirmed (the home page banner misprints it '(605)384-555'). WEBSITE confirmed.
